usage: Accord de matières : Maison de pêcheur
prompt:
A designer's material composition titled in spirit « Maison de pêcheur »: real samples of Peinture à la chaux, Pin et douglas, Lin lavé arranged together as an interior architect's still life, in the proportion Chaux sur les murs · pin en plancher · lin aux fenêtres. Mood: Côte atlantique, embruns, volets bleus.
Editorial still-life photograph for an interior design magazine, 85 mm lens, close framing where the material fills most of the frame, soft raking daylight from the side that reveals the texture, natural depth of field, true colour, no blown highlights.
LOCKS: no brand, no logo, no label, no text, no people.
